main_text.p: tes seduƈtores eam diuastare confitetur : Concinunt hisce Ioannes de Rupe-scissa Monachus, Ioannes Picus Mirandulanus Comes, Tritemius Abbas, Laurentius Valla ; Lumina Concilij Basiliensis Cardinalis Arelatensis & Thomas de Corsellis: Lapides loquitur Nicolaus ille Clemangius, Archidiaconus Baiocensis, qui iusto volumine corruptum Ecclesiæ statum liberè depinxit ; neque multò hercle parciùs, Dominicus Episcopus Brixiensis, qui etiam-tum libello suo titulum aufus præfigere Romæ reformationem : Taceo Ioachimum, PetrumAn. 1350. lib. page.notes: Marginal notes are partly faded and hard to read; the readings of the right-margin notes are approximate. The note "Ann. 1400." is at the foot of the right margin. The word "Fer-" is the catchword, and the running head is taken from the top line.
